requirements.text: Invalid input blocks submission and shows a message next to each invalid field
Errors are accessible: aria-invalid, aria-describedby to the message, and a focused error summary linking to fields
A field's error clears once the user corrects it
The server validates the same rules independently, rejects unknown fields and returns stable error codes
Field and form errors returned by the server are shown on the matching fields and can be corrected
Submission shows a busy state and duplicate submits are blocked
Unexpected failures show a safe generic message without internal details and allow retry

evidence.name: invalid form data blocks persistence and links summary errors to fields and hints
invalid form data blocks persistence and links summary errors to fields and hints
explicit server field and form errors remain editable and can be corrected
async validation and submission share one busy period and block same-tick duplicates
unexpected submission exceptions use a safe message and allow retry

implementations.notes: Declarative server-side rules with stable codes and unknown-field rejection; sharing rules with the client form is the app's wiring
